[[semantic-audit]]
== Semantic audit of repository metadata

*`semantic-audit` · validator · enforcing*

Deterministic audit of repository descriptiles: STATE/META/ECOSYSTEM exist and are non-empty; contradictions and verbatim policy restatement across descriptiles and K9 contracts; *.k9.ncl carries the K9 contract v1.0.0 required fields; root CLAUDE.md is non-empty, headed, fence-balanced, marker-free and placeholder-free.

*Assurance boundary:* Not an AI audit and not natural-language understanding. Grammar/typechecking stay with the deed-lint and k9-validate lanes; bot_directives and anchors are presence-reported only. Absent subject is not_applicable; missing toolchain is not_run (exit 2). Not referenced by main-estate-audit.

* link:../../actions/semantic-audit-check/action.yml[Action definition and inputs]
